description: Plain decode with the decode read path forced to the memory map (CAMELID_GEMMA4_GHOST_DECODE_BULK_READS=0) — the behaviour before the auto rule landed. Keep this arm: it is the control the auto rule has to beat on a RAM-starved host, and the arm that should WIN on a host whose free RAM covers the routed payload. If it ever wins here, the auto rule's threshold is wrong.
